光流分析图像的最长边上限；保持比例并对齐到 8 像素。只影响运动分析，不降低主画: Flow analysis long-edge limit; aspect preserved, 8-pixel alignment. Does not reduce main processing resolution.

默认开启。使用低分辨率结构统计检测场景变化，切换镜头时重置处理历史；不是语义场景: On by default. Low-resolution structure detects cuts and resets history; not semantic recognition. Detection-only retains no full-size temporal history.
